description: Complete the device-flow sign-in: exchanges the device_code once the operator has entered the user_code; on success the GitHub credential is stored and discovery runs. Returns ok | pending | expired | denied.

LoginStatus.description: Outcome of one poll. `SlowDown` is kept distinct from `Pending` because GitHub asks callers to lengthen their interval when it appears; the requested wait rides along in `retry_after_seconds`.

oneOf.description: Signed in; the credential is stored and discovery has been kicked.
The operator has not finished at the verification URL yet.
Polling too fast — wait `retry_after_seconds` longer before retrying.
The device code expired; start again.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to add to the poll interval; set when `status` is `slow_down`.
